flashcards.a: NW 127%, Central 115%, South 110% above; East & NE 80% below.
24 May, 8 days early (normal 1 Jun); earliest since 2009. Hiatus 29 May–16 Jun; full cover 27 Jun.
19 systems: 12 LPA + 5 Depressions + 2 Deep Depressions; 68.8 LPS-days vs ~57 normal.
Cross-equatorial flow Kenya→W coast; ≥30 kt in E Arabian Sea = rain spurt south of 20°N; 1–2 day lag to Veraval/Bombay rain.
Ganganagar–Allahabad–Calcutta at surface, slopes south to ~6 km; rain minimum on axis, maximum south + foothills.
Core Colombo–Trivandrum (Jun) → Trivandrum–Madras (Jul); mean 62–69 kt, max ~85 kt. 2025 above climatology (Aug 84 vs 60–65 kt).
West box (50–70°E) minus SE box (90–110°E) SST anomaly. pIOD = cold east / warm west.
~50% of IODs co-occur with ENSO in 100 yr; half independent via Hadley anomalies.
22 Oct ±7 d; withdrawal 4 Jan ±11 d. TN gets ~44 cm / 48% of annual rain in NE season.
Plains Tmax ≥40°C (coast 37, hills 30) + departure +4–5°C = HW; ≥+6°C = SHW; ≥45°C 2 days = HW.
1971–2020 CW frequency −0.36/decade; heat duration +1 d/decade in central/NW. El Niño favours HW, suppresses CW.
